PlayerKarteaConfigEditController

class PlayerKarteaConfigEditController(view, config, service, phase_service, message_service=None)[source]

Bases: QObject

Controller for the player Kartea config edit/create dialog.

Manages the interaction between PlayerKarteaConfigEditView and the PlayerKarteaConfig model, including field population, input validation, and data extraction. The controller talks to the view only through its form API (set_form_data, get_form_data, set_*_choices) and to data only through the injected services.

Parameters:
viewPlayerKarteaConfigEditView

The associated dialog view.

configPlayerKarteaConfig | None

Config object to edit; None creates a new config.

servicePlayerKarteaConfigService

Shared service (injected by the view factory).

phase_serviceKarteaPhaseService

Phases and levels offered in the form.

message_serviceMessageService | None, optional

Custom message service; defaults to MessageService(view).

Attributes:
viewPlayerKarteaConfigEditView

The dialog view containing the input widgets.

configPlayerKarteaConfig | None

Config instance being edited, or None when creating a new config.

ok_clickedbool

True if the dialog was accepted with valid data.

servicePlayerKarteaConfigService

Config service (players, resources, defaults).

phase_serviceKarteaPhaseService

Phase service (phase and level choices).

msgMessageService

Service used to display validation/error messages.

Methods

handle_phase_changed(phase_id)

Reload the level choices for the selected phase.

handle_ok()

Validate inputs and accept dialog if valid.

handle_cancel()

Reject dialog without saving changes.

is_input_valid()

Check required fields and show errors if needed.

get_data()

Extract entered data as a dictionary.

Notes

On creation the controller fills the player, resource and phase choices and the form: with the config data when editing (the player then cannot be changed) or with the kartea.ini defaults when creating.

The validation messages are translated with self.tr() in the “PlayerKarteaConfigEditController” context (i18n).

handle_phase_changed(phase_id)[source]

Load in the view the levels of the selected phase.

Parameters:
phase_idint | None

Selected phase; None clears the level choices.

handle_ok()[source]

Validate input and close the dialog with acceptance.

If validation passes, sets ok_clicked to True and accepts the dialog. Otherwise is_input_valid shows a critical message with the errors and the dialog stays open.

handle_cancel()[source]

Close the dialog without saving changes.

Rejects the dialog, discarding any entered data.

is_input_valid()[source]

Validate required fields.

Checks that the player, the phase and level, and the required resources (KarteaResourceFields) are filled. Shows a critical message listing all errors if validation fails.

Returns:
bool

True if all inputs are valid, False otherwise.

Notes

Resource fields that share the same message (environment right/left) produce a single error line. The messages are translated with self.tr(): the resource messages are the QT_TRANSLATE_NOOP source texts of KarteaResourceFields (i18n).

get_data()[source]

Return the current form values.

Same format that create_config/update_config expect.

Returns:
dict[str, Any]

player_id, session_id, phase_id, level_id and the other config fields. The service resolves the ids into objects.
